qa_pairs.question: What is the status of the `StdEnv/2018.3` and `StdEnv/2016.4` software environments for GROMACS?
qa_pairs.answer: Both the `StdEnv/2018.3` and `StdEnv/2016.4` software environments are deprecated and are no longer supported.

qa_pairs.question: Which modules are required to run GROMACS version 2018.3 for CPU-only calculations in the `StdEnv/2016.4` environment?
qa_pairs.answer: To run GROMACS version 2018.3 for CPU-only calculations in the `StdEnv/2016.4` environment, you need to load the modules `StdEnv/2016.4 gcc/6.4.0 openmpi/2.1.1 gromacs/2018.3`.

qa_pairs.question: How can a user load GROMACS version 2019.6 with GPU acceleration in the `StdEnv/2018.3` environment?
qa_pairs.answer: To load GROMACS version 2019.6 with GPU acceleration in the `StdEnv/2018.3` environment, a user needs to load the modules `StdEnv/2018.3 gcc/7.3.0 cuda/10.0.130 openmpi/3.1.2 gromacs/2019.6`.
